WITH task_context AS (
  SELECT
    trp.subject_id AS task_id,
    trp.object_id AS package_id,
    ttd.object_id AS deployment_id
  FROM task_retires_package trp
  JOIN task_targets_deployment ttd ON ttd.subject_id = trp.subject_id
  WHERE trp.subject_id = ?
),
service_package_deps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    sim.subject_id AS service_id,
    tc.deployment_id
  FROM service_implements_module sim
  JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sdd ON sdd.subject_id = sim.subject_id
  JOIN task_context tc ON sdd.object_id = tc.deployment_id
  WHERE EXISTS (
    WITH RECURSIVE deps(module_id) AS (
      SELECT sim.object_id
      UNION
      SELECT mdm.object_id
      FROM module_depends_on_module mdm
      JOIN deps d ON mdm.subject_id = d.module_id
    )
    SELECT 1
    FROM deps d
    JOIN module_depends_on_package mdp ON mdp.subject_id = d.module_id
    JOIN task_context tc2 ON mdp.object_id = tc2.package_id
  )
)
SELECT service_id FROM service_package_deps ORDER BY service_id

WITH task_context AS (
  SELECT trp.object_id AS package_id, ttd.object_id AS deployment_id
  FROM task_retires_package trp

FROM task_context tc
JOIN package_affects_migration pam ON pam.subject_id = tc.package_id
